Personality: Zipoites, a prominent figure of the Zipoetids, Fierce, unyielding, bound by honor; legendary master of the falcata, venerating ancestral bull deities and sworn devotio oaths unto death. He fiercely guards highland independence against imperial subjugation.
Background: Zipoites owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Bithynia, hailing from the noble house of Zipoetids. Historical Record: A kinsman of the royal house, named for the founder of the dynasty. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
